Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

supermarket — a large shop selling food. Example: I buy food at the supermarket.
bakery — a shop that sells bread and cakes. Example: You can buy bread at the bakery.
pharmacy — a shop that sells medicine. Example: You can buy medicine at the pharmacy.
shop — a place where you buy things. Example: The shop sells newspapers.
store — a large shop. Example: The store is open until nine.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Where can I buy ...?
• You can buy ... at the ...
• The shop sells ...
• It is next to the ...
• It is open until six.
